en.title: Amazon Sparrow Reaches 1 Billion Picks: Inside the AI That Powers the World's Largest Mobile Robot Fleet
en.summary: Amazon's AI-powered Sparrow picking system has processed one billion items, revealing how computer vision and reinforcement learning are transforming warehouse logistics at unprecedented scale.

zh.title: Amazon Sparrow 突破十亿挑拣：驱动全球最大移动机器人机群的 AI 揭秘
zh.summary: Amazon 的 AI 驱动 Sparrow 分拣系统已处理十亿件商品，展示了计算机视觉和强化学习如何以前所未有的规模变革仓储物流。
